criteria.text: The RLS isolation suite actually RUNS in CI: test_rls_isolation.py carries the `integration` marker so the db-integration job's `-m integration` filter selects it (previously all 25 tests were silently deselected).
A workspace-A user cannot SELECT another workspace's rows (projects/project_revisions/workspace_settings/announcements/songs/templates/fonts) — returns 0 rows.
A workspace-A user cannot INSERT into another workspace (WITH CHECK rejects → InsufficientPrivilege).
A workspace-A user cannot UPDATE another workspace's rows (projects/announcements/songs/templates/workspace_settings) — affects 0 rows.
A workspace-A user cannot DELETE another workspace's rows across every workspace table — affects 0 rows; the target rows survive (verified via owner connection).
